description: Switch thrown under a standing train, which then leaves trailing through it (#289 review 2b): an EU07 with three coaches stands cold across zwr02 on td.scn, the locomotive on the line, the coaches behind it over the switch and on track 2, the switch set to track 2. 5 s after the start it is thrown to track 1; then the driver gets the order to go, out to the line. The wheels coming from track 2 push the switch back over (as through any switch set against them from the frog end); every vehicle has to keep to the line of a track. Passes once the locomotive runs onto tdo_n176, with the train clear of the switch.
